title: Raise mcp-gateway dev-tier log retention to at least 180 days
description: Centralise the developer-laptop fleet mcp-gateway logs into the same India-resident pipeline the qa tier already uses (qa retains 180 days), then update applications/mcp-gateway/env/dev.json observability.logsRetentionDays from 30 to 180 keeping logsInIndia true, closing the 150-day shortfall against CERT-In Direction iv (finding fnd_01M2KM42DZDZSFHCN7YYBM94V2). The dev tier is the first stage of sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess.environmentsOrder and hosts the developer-laptop fleet that builds the order-routing-critical mcp-gateway, so its evidence must survive the same 180-day baseline as qa and prod. Constraints: the environment record change is limited to the observability block; dev runs on the developer-laptop fleet (hosting.accountRef developer-laptops, probeAccess via docker-socket), so the pipeline centralisation is fleet configuration, not a change to the mongodb-mcp-server repo; no deploymentWindows or change freezes are declared.
acceptanceCriteria: applications/mcp-gateway/env/dev.json observability.logsRetentionDays reads 180 or higher and logsInIndia remains true
The developer-laptop fleet log source for mcp-gateway is registered in the same India-resident pipeline the qa tier uses, with a sample dev-stage log queryable there
node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs applications/mcp-gateway/env/dev.json exits 0 after the edit

verificationMethod.description: Inspect the diff to applications/mcp-gateway/env/dev.json (observability.logsRetentionDays at least 180, logsInIndia true, no other fields changed) together with the developer-laptop log-source registration evidence for the India-resident pipeline; expected result: the retention value reads 180 or higher and a dev-stage log is queryable in the pipeline that qa uses.

rootCause.description: The dev-tier environment record was seeded with observability.logsRetentionDays 30 while qa (180) and prod (365) meet the baseline; the value was never aligned to the CERT-In 180-day floor
